headline: Markets closed today for Diwali-Balipratipada; Sensex and Nifty reached eight-month highs in last session

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Thursday, 12 November.

why: NSE and BSE are closed today on account of the Diwali-Balipratipada holiday.
On the last trading day, Sensex and Nifty extended gains to close at their highest levels in over eight months.
Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty 50 have surged over 6% across the past 5 sessions.
India VIX rose 18% in the last 3 weeks and 68% over the past 47 days.
whatHappening: Blackstone agreed to acquire roughly a 16% stake in India's IIFL Finance for $535 million.
Individual ownership in NSE-listed companies climbed to a record high of 19.5% in Q2FY27.
PHDCCI outlined Budget 2027 expectations, demanding LTCG tax removal and LNG duty waivers.
Bullion prices took a hit globally, with gold dropping over 2% due to hotter US inflation data.
summary: Indian stock exchanges NSE and BSE are closed today for Diwali-Balipratipada and will reopen on Thursday, 12 November. On the last trading day, Sensex and Nifty extended their rally to finish at eight-month highs after gaining over 6% across five sessions. In corporate news, Blackstone announced a $535 million deal to acquire a 16% stake in IIFL Finance.
